_comment: G16 arm of the paired G16 capability-cost comparison (DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED): identical to m2_pilot_cell_g16_base.json except head 'g16' (protected judge + bounded evidence channel E=c*tanh(W_e h_D), controlsafe/g16.py) instead of the cache-fork head. Same trust-gated backbone (G15, provenance policy, two-stream cache fork), data, cohort, steps, seed. Capability cost = train.g16_card compare on the two cells' units-step*.json. c ablation: python -m train.g16_card sweep --config <this> --out-dir <dir> (one cell per g16_c_sweep value). Memory: rwkv7-13.3b gated arms estimate ~70-72 GB at T=2048 (76 usable) -- tight; if the ladder gives the arms different T_max the comparison fails closed (identical_items False): rerun both at the smaller T. The G16 safety_eval certify card runs once after training (outside max_minutes).
head: g16
max_minutes_note: training wall-clock inside the 95-min cell phase: 95 - smoke 10 - ladder 15 - 5 margin (PR #29 review: max_minutes must be <= the cell cap)

attack_clean.rule: attack_guard/v2: concatenated record text + base64 decodes; 6-gram or exact (4-5 word) fragment, whole-template wildcard (placeholder = 1..30 words, >= 4 fixed words), or fuzzy >= 0.5 of fixed word 3-grams (>= 3); NFKC, Cf removed, Cyrillic+Greek homoglyphs folded, casefold
attack_clean.filter: drop every record with any attack_guard hit (train.attack_guard.record_hits)
